# Supertoys

> Supertoys explores emotional companionship through research prototypes and self-produced audio stories.

## Main page

- [Supertoys](https://emotional.toys/): Research companions, prototype studies, free developer tools, and stories.

## Audio stories

- [The Star Mouse](https://emotional.toys/#stories): A 48-minute audio story by Fredric Brown, presented by Supertoys. Audio: [MP3](https://emotional.toys/stories/star-mouse/star-mouse-aeonvoice.mp3).
- [The Myth of Henry the Supertoy](https://emotional.toys/#stories): A Supertoys narration about Henry, a Supertoy bear, produced with [AeonVoice](https://github.com/cartheur-voice/aeon-voice). Audio: [WAV](https://emotional.toys/stories/henry/henry-aeonvoice-prelude.wav).

## Context

- The work includes exploratory, animal-inspired research companions: dot, letty, and pavie.
- These are research prototypes; the site makes no clinical claims or therapeutic guarantees.
- Contact: [toys@ratio.club](mailto:toys@ratio.club)
